Topic: Science in daily life
Outline: 1) Introduction 2) Scientific wonders 3) Medical inventions 4) Disadvantages of science 5) Conclusion
"Science of today is, the Technology of Tomorrow" ~ Edward Teller

Introduction:
Science has made the life of man easy as well as comfortable. It has given a lot to mankind. Due to scientific inventions, the life-style of men has improved. He can travel globally in a short time, enjoy luxury in all aspects, etc.
"Science is like a victory of man"

Scientific wonders:
Science has done wonders in our life. Due to scientific inventions our life has become easy. Electricity is one of its most important inventions. All the fans, coolers, televisions, etc. run by electricity. Big machines are also run by electricity.
"Science is like a magic in everybody's life"

Medical Inventions:
Science has brought many useful medicines. Vaccines are invented to prevent many diseases like polio, cholera, small pox, etc. It has increased the rate of living in a man. Many health equipments have also developed as a result of science. The most current contribution of science was at the time of corona pandemic. Because of our scientists only we have become successful in eliminating and preventing that deadly virus.
"Science has protected our life, we must use it wise."

Disadvantages of science:
Every coin has its two sides. Science too has a dark side. While it has improved the life of an individual, it has also gave birth to its destruction. Nuclear and atom bombs have been discovered that are giving a serious impact within us. The smoke and contaminated water released from the industries are polluting our environment. Trees are being cut for setting up laboratories and factories as well. It is giving rise to environmental degradation we have to give a serious attention to this problem.
Science can be both, a curse or a boon!!!

Conclusion:
Science has a power within itself. If it is used wisely and for the sake of humanity, it would be useful. Misuse of this power can lead to the final destruction of the world. We all must take proper attention for it.

GOOD HABBITS
Good habits are the good manners that cause human's personality and make him a fit citizen. People like to have friendship with those who are good mannered. The way we behave, represent ourselves, personal hygiene are counted as manners.
Some habits which can improve a child are such as: doing some exercise, getting up early, going to bed early, respecting elders and teachers, maintaining cleanliness around us, and going to bed early.
Good manners are very important for the moral, mental, physical as well as social development of a child.
It is well said that - "Manners make a man"
